/.title: The OneGodian App
/.headline: One dashboard for identity, systems, records, education, commerce, and verification.
/.body: The OneGodian App is the central public and member-facing experience layer for the OneGodian ecosystem. It connects dashboards, identity pathways, registry access, certificates, tools, media, products, and documentation into one structured interface designed for actual use rather than placeholder navigation.
sections: Structured navigation across the OneGodian platform stack
Grounded documentation, tools, records, and product access
Clear separation from privileged console and operator controls

/dashboard.title: Dashboard
/dashboard.headline: Your OneGodian ecosystem overview.
/dashboard.body: This dashboard is the experience layer of the ecosystem. It should bring together member identity, active tools, certificates, account-linked resources, ecosystem entry points, and recommended next actions. It is not the internal control plane. Operator-only routing, approvals, execution controls, and policy mutation belong outside the app on the separate console surface.

/ecosystem.title: Ecosystem
/ecosystem.headline: Understand how each OneGodian domain works together.
/ecosystem.body: The ecosystem is organized by role. OneGodian.org is the civil, cultural, educational, and human-facing explanation layer. OneGodian.com is the commerce and identity product layer. app.OneGodian.com is the unified public and member-facing application layer. OMOS.OneGodian.com is the operational intelligence and systems architecture layer. QuantumOHI.com is the enterprise-facing systems positioning layer. QRV.Network is the verification and credential infrastructure layer. u.OneGodian.com supports courses and learning pathways, and galaxy.OneGodian.com supports lore, timelines, and exploratory systems.

/omos.title: OMOS Runtime
/omos.headline: Connect the app to OMOS.OneGodian.com.
/omos.body: OMOS is the OneGodian Metaphysical Operating System. It includes the OneGodian Algorithm, OHI model synthesis, identity and belief mapping, institutional and legal framing, AI interaction standards, and broader operating logic for the ecosystem. Within the domain architecture, OMOS.OneGodian.com should function as the protocol, manifest, runtime, and systems reference surface that the app can read from and connect to where appropriate.

/registry.title: Registry
/registry.headline: Access OneGodian records, certificates, and verification pathways.
/registry.body: The registry page should organize identity records, certificate references, public identifiers, QRV verification links, chronology references, and documentation pathways. Verification should be presented as a trust and documentation function, not as a claim of public governmental authority. In all institutional and legal contexts, Gregorian dates remain the controlling reference and OneGodian Time remains the internal sequencing layer.

/tools.title: Tools
/tools.headline: Use OneGodian tools for reflection, records, and navigation.
/tools.body: The app tool layer should stay focused on public and member-facing utility surfaces: Belief Mapper, OneGodian Time tools, certificate lookup, contributor intake, ecosystem navigation, and related identity or educational utilities. If a feature is operator-facing, privileged, or execution-governing, it does not belong in the app. The app should remain clear, useful, and stable for normal users.

/members.title: Members
/members.headline: Explore voluntary OneGodian membership and contributor pathways.
/members.body: The members area supports identity pathways, community participation, contributor onboarding, membership products, and profile infrastructure. Public and member language should remain voluntary, non-coercive, and institutionally clear. The Identity & Belief Mapper can support staged pathways such as Seeker, Believer, OneGodian, and Elder, with emphasis on understanding, participation, contribution, and continuity rather than pressure or compulsion.

/certificates.title: Certificates
/certificates.headline: View and verify certificates, badges, and completion records.
/certificates.body: Certificates should provide clear, structured recognition for courses, participation, membership-linked records, contributor activity, and verified digital products where enabled. QRV integration should support public verification without exposing private account data, and certificate pages should connect naturally back to registry, chronology, and profile surfaces.

/products.title: Products
/products.headline: Access OneGodian products, memberships, downloads, and learning resources.
/products.body: The product layer should help users discover what exists and route them to the appropriate commerce surface. The broader split is straightforward: product discovery, books, founder products, courses, merch, and content-driven items align naturally with the WooCommerce side, while subscriptions, licensing, premium access, developer tooling, and API plans align more naturally with Stripe-backed intent-driven flows. WooCommerce monetizes traffic. Stripe monetizes intent.

/media.title: Media
/media.headline: Watch, listen, read, and share OneGodian media.
/media.body: The media area should organize videos, music, campaign assets, founder updates, educational clips, branded visuals, and public-facing narrative materials. It is also a natural place to surface the OneGodian: Remember campaign, identity clarification clips, creator-compatible public media, and youth-facing short-form content tied to the broader Gen Alpha and Gen Beta positioning work.

/settings.title: Settings
/settings.headline: Manage your profile, preferences, and app access.
/settings.body: Settings should remain clean, practical, and member-oriented. This area should manage profile information, preferences, notification controls, privacy options, connected services, display settings, and export pathways where supported. It should not drift into privileged operator administration or execution-governing controls.

/docs.title: Documentation
/docs.headline: Read the operating documents behind the ecosystem.
/docs.body: The docs area should make the ecosystem legible. It should explain what ONEGODIAN, LLC is today, how the domains are split, what OMOS contains, how OneGodian Time works, how institutional language should be handled, and what the current stabilization phase requires. This is where the app moves from placeholder copy into a usable documentation layer.

/docs/overview.title: ONEGODIAN, LLC Overview
/docs/overview.headline: ONEGODIAN, LLC is in a live infrastructure buildout phase.
/docs/overview.body: As of May 26, 2026, ONEGODIAN, LLC is best understood as a systems and infrastructure company, digital platform ecosystem, publishing and intellectual property operation, software and deployment environment, commerce and educational framework, and long-term operational architecture project. The current emphasis is increasingly practical: operational execution, production infrastructure, revenue systems, deployment reliability, platform consolidation, and scalable architecture.

/docs/omos.title: OneGodian Metaphysical Operating System
/docs/omos.headline: OMOS is the structured operating logic layer behind the ecosystem.
/docs/omos.body: OMOS includes the OneGodian Algorithm, OHI model synthesis, Identity & Belief Mapper, institutional and legal layer, AGI alignment and cyber-security concepts, unified economic cosmos, and the broader OneGodian philosophy and infrastructure roadmap. It also anchors public references to the Belief Mapper, journey stages, identity tools, OneGodian Time, and the relationship between human-facing layers and system-facing layers.

/docs/time.title: OneGodian Time
/docs/time.headline: OneGodian Time is a dual-dating framework with Gregorian legal control.
/docs/time.body: The fixed epoch is March 18, 2025 = Genesis 01, 0000 OT. Gregorian Time remains the controlling legal date for court filings, contracts, banking documents, tax matters, government correspondence, and institutional use. OneGodian Time functions as the internal sequencing and governance layer. Months 1 through 12 are standardized at 30 days each, and Ascension is a 5 or 6 day year-end alignment period, creating a 365 or 366 day structure. Public and app-facing date tools should always keep that hierarchy clear.

/docs/domain-clarity.title: Domain Clarity
/docs/domain-clarity.headline: Each OneGodian surface has a different job.
/docs/domain-clarity.body: OneGodian.org is the civil, cultural, educational, and human-facing domain. OneGodian.com is the commerce and identity product platform. app.OneGodian.com is the public and member-facing application layer. OMOS.OneGodian.com is the systems and protocol reference layer. QuantumOHI.com is enterprise-facing technical positioning. QRV.Network is the verification and credential infrastructure layer. Clear domain separation protects usability, legal clarity, and long-term system discipline.

/docs/founder-perspective.title: Founder Perspective
/docs/founder-perspective.headline: The current shift is from conceptual expansion into disciplined execution.
/docs/founder-perspective.body: The strongest operational theme in the current phase is not adding more concepts. It is making systems real, reducing fragmentation, eliminating duplication, standardizing infrastructure, and turning architecture into functioning operational layers. The app should reflect that same shift by replacing generic filler with clear pathways, grounded copy, real documentation, and usable entry points.

/docs/gen-alpha-beta.title: Gen Alpha & Gen Beta Positioning
/docs/gen-alpha-beta.headline: ONEGODIAN is best positioned as a digitally native identity and interaction framework.
/docs/gen-alpha-beta.body: The strongest public framing is not replacement government or compulsory ideology. It is a digitally native identity and interaction framework designed for people growing up in AI-mediated environments. The key strengths are linguistic clarity, lightweight identity reflection tools, AI-aware positioning, creator compatibility, and human-centered interaction design. Participation remains voluntary, exploratory, and non-coercive.

/docs/redevelopment.title: Municipal & Economic Development Framing
/docs/redevelopment.headline: Lead with practical redevelopment, operations, and productive use.
/docs/redevelopment.body: For municipal, redevelopment, lender, insurer, contractor, and institutional conversations, ONEGODIAN, LLC should be presented as a Connecticut-based private commercial enterprise focused on creative technology, digital media, operational infrastructure, education platforms, systems development, adaptive property reuse, and productive economic redevelopment. Avoid sovereign nation-state or governmental framing. Use clear commercial and redevelopment language focused on rehabilitation, infrastructure, compliance, productive land use, and long-term viability.

/docs/stabilization.title: Founder Infrastructure Stabilization
/docs/stabilization.headline: The current phase is defined by stabilization of four foundational systems.
/docs/stabilization.body: The present priorities are: an official business operations location, a stable executive living environment, reliable company transportation infrastructure, and sustainable recurring digital revenue systems. The current challenge is not lack of ideas. It is operational consolidation, infrastructure stability, focused monetization, founder sustainability, and repeatable execution. The app should support that correction by becoming more useful, more legible, and more connected to real platform pathways.
